metadata.description: Agent skills for iOS and Swift development

plugins.name: app-store-release
plugins.description: Automate App Store Connect release chores through Apple's official API instead of the website: check where a version, build upload or review stands and why a build failed, draft release notes from git history and push them as localized "What's New", pull and push store listing text, find missing localizations (listing, in-app purchases, Game Center), create versions and attach builds, upload screenshots, submit for App Review, release approved versions, and read or reply to customer reviews. Use whenever the user wants to ship, release or submit an iOS app version, asks where a version or build stands or why a build is missing, or wants release notes, listing text, localization gaps, screenshots or review replies handled, even if they never mention the API or this skill by name.

plugins.name: all-skills
plugins.description: Every skill in this repository, installed together.
